summary_en: This study compares TAK-928 with docetaxel in adults with unresectable, advanced or metastatic squamous or nonsquamous non-small cell lung cancer whose disease progressed after immunotherapy and platinum-based chemotherapy. TAK-928 and the comparator docetaxel are both given by IV infusion, and treatment can last up to 24 months, depending on response and side effects. The main aim is to learn how well TAK-928 works compared with docetaxel; the specific primary outcome measure is not stated, and the study is a Phase 3 trial.
summary_es: Este estudio compara TAK-928 con docetaxel en adultos con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas escamoso o no escamoso, irresecable, avanzado o metastásico, cuya enfermedad progresó después de inmunoterapia y quimioterapia basada en platino. TAK-928 y el medicamento de comparación, docetaxel, se administran ambos por infusión intravenosa, y el tratamiento puede durar hasta 24 meses, según la respuesta y los efectos secundarios. El objetivo principal es conocer qué tan bien funciona TAK-928 en comparación con docetaxel; la medida de resultado principal específica no está indicada, y el estudio es de Fase 3.
who_for: Unresectable, advanced or metastatic squamous or nonsquamous NSCLC with radiographic disease progression.
Progression on or after anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy and platinum-based doublet chemotherapy, with at least 6 weeks of anti-PD-1/PD-L1 exposure.
At least one measurable lesion by CT or MRI per RECIST v1.1.
Expected survival of at least 3 months.
not_for: Squamous NSCLC with a known actionable genomic alteration in the listed driver genes.
Nonsquamous NSCLC without prior documented negative testing for the listed driver gene mutations.
Low blood counts, or abnormal liver or kidney test results at baseline.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or intending to become pregnant during or within 6 months after treatment.
